lines.tgt: Fresh mountain air dries the meat allowing acorn fat to penetrate the muscle marbling.

lines.src: Cada fina loncha cortada a mano ofrece una textura suave y un sabor gastronómico legendario.
lines.tgt: Every thin hand-cut slice offers a smooth texture and a legendary culinary flavor.
